verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for bulk operations across many items, such as bulk refunds, bulk merchant updates, or batch API endpoints for multiple objects. The API batch-close feature is a settlement step that closes out a terminal or store batch, not a general bulk action over many items, so it is adjacent at best. Viewing all subscriptions in the Dashboard is listing and management, not bulk execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
